rules.exploit: Authenticate directly to the SSH service with authorized root credentials or an authorized root SSH key.
Attempt authentication with credentials obtained during the assessment against the SSH service.

rules.description: SSH permits authentication using accounts with empty passwords.
rules.exploit: Attempt SSH authentication using an enabled account with an empty password.

rules.description: SSH TCP forwarding is enabled and may permit users to tunnel access to otherwise inaccessible services.
rules.exploit: Authenticate to SSH and create a TCP tunnel through the host to an internal service that is not directly reachable.
